relationships.subject: Deucrictibant
relationships.evidence_quote: Deucrictibant is a specific, orally bioavailable, competitive antagonist of the bradykinin B2 receptor currently under investigation for hereditary angioedema.

relationships.subject: Deucrictibant
relationships.evidence_quote: Deucrictibant has the potential to effectively and safely treat and prevent angioedema attacks due to acquired C1-inhibitor deficiency.

key_findings: In a 3-patient crossover trial, deucrictibant reduced attack severity and monthly attack rates to 0.0.
